task_name: Remove the disconnected window source and legacy recovery

rubric.result: The exact review diff deletes all three disconnected source modules. The recursive census checks source paths and contents case-insensitively; read-only source searches found no remaining transport references.

The literal planned test asserts empty path and content matches over backend/src using /cmux/i. Its nested temporary offending file is detected by both assertions; restoring the deleted transport source would fail the real-source assertions.
No replacement signature, error or constant contract is prescribed. The quoted WorktreePlans import disappears with its explicitly retired module.

Retirement preserves record-based recovery: ct-api still constructs RecordedPlanRecovery, whose surviving suite asserts restart discovery, uncertain incomplete calls without relaunch, pending continuation, projection refresh and review-watch recovery. Coordinator and conversation-record suites remain present; no closed decision is reopened.

All eight CT yardsticks were considered. The existing SourceTree helper is extended in English TypeScript with class methods, real filesystem inputs and cleanup. defects.md: closed vocabulary introduces no classification defect; raw map return shape predates this diff and no new shape is introduced; two fields that have to agree or absence sentinels are not introduced; no new error is named for its location. No new production boundary, duplicated business decision or speculative abstraction is added.

The brief explicitly orders deletion of both obsolete suites and replacement of the old source census. This authorizes all removed cases, including the parameterized invalid-marker cases within the retired recovery suite. Surviving record-based recovery assertions are untouched.

Actual production modules are deleted. The guard reads the real source tree, and its temporary nested file is created independently with mkdirSync/writeFileSync rather than through SourceTree. Separate path and content predicates inspect actual filesystem evidence without mutating source.

All six changed files and their changes serve the explicit deletion-and-census task. Protected plugin files, plans, state and unrelated implementation are untouched. Controls 1 green is inherited; log reference only: .agent/run-331/task-20-controls-1.log.

The new guard is deterministic for a given source tree, sorts match lists, uses a unique temporary fixture and removes it in afterEach. Assertions inspect real source paths/content and would fail with the retired source restored; no clock, network, subprocess or mock outcome establishes success.
